description: Lists registration, IFTA, IRP, DOT inspection, emissions, permit and highway-use-tax requirements for a US state (or DC) plus the federal items, each with its official source link and the date it was checked. Give a GVWR (and axles, and whether it crosses state lines) to also check CDL, USDOT, IFTA, IRP and Form 2290 weight thresholds. From Torgix's rulebook of 355 cited items. Not legal advice.

axles.description: Number of axles on the power unit

gvwr_lbs.description: Gross vehicle weight rating in pounds, to check weight thresholds

interstate.description: True if the vehicle crosses state lines

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, or DC

name: state_compliance_requirements
title: State and federal compliance requirements
